goal: Set up client-side routing for an app with a root layout, an index page, and an item detail page that loads its data before rendering and shows a 404 message when the item is missing. Export the root component that mounts the router.

Write a route component with a form that creates a todo: validate the title on submit, show the validation error next to the field, disable the button while the submission is in flight, and redirect to the list on success.
Write a like button component that submits to another route without navigating, shows the new state optimistically while the request is pending, and reads the result when it returns.
Write a product list component with a search box and page number kept in the URL query string, updating the URL as the user types without adding history entries.
Write the route configuration file for a framework-mode app: a home page, a dashboard layout with nested settings and billing pages, a dynamic user profile page, and a catch-all not-found page.

Write a framework-mode route module for a user profile page: load the user on the server, set the page title from the loaded data, handle a form post that updates the display name, and render an error boundary.

Add an authentication check that runs before every route under /app, redirects anonymous visitors to /login with the original path remembered, and makes the current user available to the loaders below it.

Write an editor route component that warns before navigating away with unsaved changes, and a loader that returns the critical data immediately while a slow list of comments streams in later behind a loading placeholder.
